messages:
Josh Support: FYI escalating ACME trial (acct: acme-trial-112). Activation dropped yesterday, customer said they're "considering alternatives" in notes. Repeated 429s during embed ingest and higher latency. Need CS handoff, high priority.

Anna CS: Thanks @Josh. Can you paste the recent error snippet + renewal date? Also confirm whether a CSM is already assigned.

Josh Support: Renewal date 2024-06-12, no CSM assigned. Error snippet below: 
```
2024-04-15T14:12:01Z ERROR api: 429 Too Many Requests token=acct:acme-trial-112 region=us-east-1 path=/v1/embeddings
```
Also seeing latency spikes 800-1200ms on embedding calls.

Maria SE: Adding context — they're batching at 32, seq_len ~512, model redwood-embed-4b. Likely overload on prefix/cache mismatch. Quick recommendation: reduce batch to 8 and enable prefix caching. I can run a config test.

Anna CS: Proposed comms plan: 1) Immediate outreach to acknowledge and set 24h mitigation SLA; 2) SE to apply temporary config changes and monitor 4h; 3) If no improvement, propose quota bump or Dedicated pilot and escalate to Solutions Director; 4) Track renewal risk and flag execs if unresolved in 7d.
Assigning: Maria SE -> run config change + monitor; Josh Support -> collect ratelimit headers, full logs; Kyle CSM -> customer outreach + set renewal risk note. Tentative 30-min sync at 15:30 UTC today. @Kyle can you lead outreach?

Kyle CSM: On it. I’ll send the invite to the customer and internal attendees. Quick Q — do they have soft credits left?

Josh Support: Yes about 500 credits left. Also created internal incident ticket INC-4987 with logs.

DevOpsBot: Incident INC-4987 created by Josh Support — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4987 :white_check_mark:

Anna CS: Maria, please post the exact commands you'll run and expected rollback steps. Also we should prepare a short customer note template. I can draft.

Maria SE: Plan to run: 
```
# reduce batch size
rc set embed.batch_size=8 --env prod
# enable prefix caching
rc set embed.cache_prefix=true --env prod
# monitor metrics for 4 hours
```
Rollback: revert batch_size to 32 and disable cache_prefix if errors appear. I'll capture perf graphs.

Anna CS: Good. If the fix works within 24h, we keep standard support path and no exec escalate. If not, escalate to Solutions Director and propose Dedicated pilot. @everyone :eyes: :mag:

Josh Support: Acknowledged — I'll keep this thread updated with ratelimit headers and any customer responses. :thumbsup:

Kyle CSM: Invite sent and customer replied they can join at 15:30 UTC. I'll send the acknowledgement note now and include the mitigation plan.

Maria SE: Starting the config changes now, will post metrics after 30m and 4h.

Anna CS: Thanks team. I'll draft the customer acknowledgement & risk note and post in the thread in 10m.
